```{r}
player_df <- read.csv("C:/Users/matth/Downloads/womens_aggregated_session.csv")
sessions_df <- read.csv("C:/Users/matth/Downloads/womens_soccer_select.csv")
```

```{r}
player_df$athlete_relative_age <- as.factor(player_df$athlete_relative_age)
sessions_df$athlete_relative_age <- as.factor(sessions_df$athlete_relative_age)
```

```{r}
ggplot(player_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = w_max_speed_kph, fill = athlete_relative_age)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Max Speed by Relative Age (Player Aggregated)",
       x = "Relative Age",
       y = "Max Speed (kph)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
### CLEAN BOXPLOTS FOR TOTAL DISTANCE

# --- Create summary dataframe ---
summary_df <- player_df %>%
  group_by(athlete_relative_age) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(w_total_distance, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(w_total_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(w_total_distance, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_pos = as.numeric(factor(athlete_relative_age))
  )

# --- Overall median for reference line ---
overall_median <- median(player_df$w_total_distance, na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Plot ---
ggplot(player_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = w_total_distance)) +
  
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#4E79A7", width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  # Overall median reference line
  geom_hline(yintercept = overall_median, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  
  # --- Labels ---
  # Q1 (left)
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.35, y = Q1, label = round(Q1, 0)),
            size = 4, hjust = 1) +
  
  # Median (centered, emphasized)
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos, y = Median, label = round(Median, 0)),
            size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", vjust = -0.5) +
  
  # Q3 (left)
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.35, y = Q3, label = round(Q3, 0)),
            size = 4, hjust = 1) +
  
  # Labels & theme
  labs(
    title = "Total Distance by Relative Age",
    subtitle = "Quartiles and median shown; dashed line = overall median",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Total Distance (meters)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Create summary dataframe ---
summary_df <- player_df %>%
  group_by(athlete_relative_age) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(w_total_distance, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(w_total_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(w_total_distance, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x_pos = as.numeric(factor(athlete_relative_age))
  )

# --- Overall median ---
overall_median <- median(player_df$w_total_distance, na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Plot ---
ggplot(player_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = w_total_distance)) +
  
  # Boxplot (slightly stronger fill for contrast with white text)
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#4E79A7", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  # Overall median reference line
  geom_hline(yintercept = overall_median,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  
  # --- Quartile labels ---
  # Q1 (left)
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.35, y = Q1, label = round(Q1, 0)),
            size = 4, hjust = 1, color = "gray30") +
  
  # Median (centered, white, below line)
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos, y = Median, label = round(Median, 0)),
            size = 4.5, fontface = "bold",
            vjust = 1.2,
            color = "white") +
  
  # Q3 (left)
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.35, y = Q3, label = round(Q3, 0)),
            size = 4, hjust = 1, color = "gray30") +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Total Distance by Relative Age",
    subtitle = "Quartiles and median shown; dashed line = overall median",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Total Distance (meters)"
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14),
    
    # Larger axis text for presentation
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    
    # Axis titles
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
    
    # Clean grid
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
plot_player_highlight <- function(player_id, metric, y_label) {
  
  highlight_df <- player_df %>%
    filter(athlete_number == player_id)
  
  ggplot(player_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = .data[[metric]])) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgray", alpha = 0.7) +
    
    geom_point(data = highlight_df,
               aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = .data[[metric]]),
               color = "red", size = 4) +
    
    labs(title = paste(y_label, "- Athlete", player_id),
         x = "Relative Age",
         y = y_label) +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_player_highlight(1018, "w_max_speed_kph", "Max Speed (kph)")
plot_player_highlight(1018, "w_total_distance", "Total Distance")
plot_player_highlight(1018, "w_session_load", "Session Load")
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility (optional)

random_session <- sessions_df %>%
  sample_n(1)

random_session
player_id <- random_session$athlete_number
player_age <- random_session$athlete_relative_age
player_speed <- random_session$max_speed_kph
player_percentile <- random_session$max_speed_perc_rank

ggplot(sessions_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = max_speed_kph)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgray", alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # highlight THIS session
  geom_point(data = random_session,
             aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = max_speed_kph),
             color = "red", size = 4) +
  
  geom_text(data = random_session,
            aes(label = paste0("P", round(max_speed_perc_rank))),
            vjust = -1.2,
            color = "red") +
  
  labs(
    title = paste("Session Max Speed Benchmark - Athlete", player_id),
    subtitle = paste("Max Speed:", round(player_speed, 2), "kph | Percentile:", round(player_percentile), "%"),
    x = "Relative Age",
    y = "Max Speed (kph)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```

# FINAL UPDATED BOXPLOTS

```{r}
### TOTAL DISTANCE

ggplot(player_df, aes(x = athlete_relative_age, y = w_total_distance)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "#4E79A7",
    alpha = 0.6,
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black",
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Q1
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.4, y = Q1,
                label = paste0(scales::comma(round(Q1, 0)), " m")),
            size = 4, hjust = 1, color = "gray30") +
  
  # Median
  geom_label(data = summary_df,
             aes(x = x_pos, y = Median,
                 label = paste0(scales::comma(round(Median, 0)), " m")),
             size = 4.8,
             fontface = "bold",
             fill = "white",
             color = "black",
             label.size = 0) +
  
  # Q3
  geom_text(data = summary_df,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.4, y = Q3,
                label = paste0(scales::comma(round(Q3, 0)), " m")),
            size = 4, hjust = 1, color = "gray30") +
  
  labs(
    title = "Average Total Distance Covered by Age",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Total Distance (meters)",
    caption = "Boxes show cut-offs for 25th and 75th percentiles; center label = median"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray85", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    # Improved caption
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "gray30",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 20, b = 10, l = 40)
  )
```

```{r}
    alpha = 0.6,
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black",
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Q1
  geom_text(data = summary_df_sprint,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.4, y = Q1,
                label = round(Q1, 1)),
            size = 4, hjust = 1, color = "gray30") +
  
  # Median (highlighted)
  geom_label(data = summary_df_sprint,
             aes(x = x_pos, y = Median,
                 label = round(Median, 1)),
             size = 4.8,
             fontface = "bold",
             fill = "white",
             color = "black",
             label.size = 0) +
  
  # Q3
  geom_text(data = summary_df_sprint,
            aes(x = x_pos - 0.4, y = Q3,
                label = round(Q3, 1)),
            size = 4, hjust = 1, color = "gray30") +
  
  labs(
    title = "Average Sprint Events by Age",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Sprint Events",
    caption = "Boxes show cut-offs for 25th and 75th percentiles; center label = median"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray85", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "gray30",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 20, b = 10, l = 40)
  )
```
